iptables -t nat -D POSTROUTING -s 10.66.66.0/24 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE; iptables -D FORWARD -i wg0 -j ACCEPT; iptables -D FORWARD -o wg0 -j ACCEPT; ip6tables -D FORWARD -i wg0 -j ACCEPT; ip6tables -D FORWARD -o wg0 -j ACCEPT; ip6tables -D FORWARD -i eth1 -o wg0 -j ACCEPT; ip -6 neigh del proxy 2a00:7c80:0:1d8:a00::2 dev eth1; ip -6 neigh del proxy 2a00:7c80:0:1d8:a00::3 dev eth1; iptables -t nat -D PREROUTING -p tcp -i eth0 --dport 37015 -m comment --comment 3ax-fwd-uuid-2 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.66.66.3:37015; iptables -t nat -D PREROUTING -p udp -i eth0 --dport 37015 -m comment --comment 3ax-fwd-uuid-2 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.66.66.3:37015; iptables -D FORWARD -d 10.66.66.3 -p tcp -o wg0 --dport 37015 -m comment --comment 3ax-fwd-uuid-2 -j ACCEPT; iptables -D FORWARD -d 10.66.66.3 -p udp -o wg0 --dport 37015 -m comment --comment 3ax-fwd-uuid-2 -j ACCEPT
